blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Razon-led Primelectric Holdings Inc. is entering into a joint venture with South Cotabato II Electric Cooperative (Socoteco II) after a plebiscite approved the proposed deal. In a statement, Ignite Power and Energy Holdings Inc. said the cooperative’s overall plebiscite committee proclaimed the final results on Sunday, with 137,978 member-consumer-owners (MCOs) supporting the conditional joint venture agreement. READ: Tinio presses need to probe Socoteco II deal: ‘Will consumers benefit?’ Nearly 5,000 MCOs, meanwhile, voted against the proposal. The affirmative votes represented 60.91 percent of the 226,534 eligible voters on the final master list. Voters cast a total of 142,789 valid votes […]...
